nphi.title: LabTrain 2.0 – Sustainable drug quality control and laboratory standards in West and South-East Africa
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: African Medicines Quality Forum; Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority; FDA Ghana; Institut National de Santé Publique du Burundi; Liberia Medicines & Health Products Regulatory Authority; Medicines Control Agency The Gambia; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; Namibia Medicines Regulatory Council; Pharmacy Board of Sierra Leone; WHO; InphA (Germany)
nphi.summary: Strengthens national drug quality control laboratories to meet international standards and secure access to safe medicines.

nphi.title: Global Laboratory Leadership Programme (GLLP)
nphi.with: WHO; ECDC; FAO; WOAH (OIE); Association of Public Health Laboratories; implementing countries incl. Pakistan and Liberia
nphi.summary: CDC co-developed the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme with WHO, ECDC, APHL, FAO and WOAH. Its One Health learning package trains national laboratory leaders and has been rolled out in countries including Pakistan and Liberia.

nphi.title: JICA–NMIMR Third Country Training Programme for African national laboratories
nphi.with: Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research (NMIMR); national laboratory staff of West and Central African countries
nphi.summary: A JICA-funded laboratory training series hosted by Ghana's Noguchi Memorial Institute, launched after the West Africa Ebola outbreak, training national laboratory professionals from West, Central and Southern African countries in…

nphi.title: CDC Liberia – support to NPHIL
nphi.with: Ministry of Health; National Public Health Institute of Liberia (NPHIL); National Public Health Reference Laboratory; Liberia FETP; National Malaria Control Program
nphi.summary: CDC has worked in Liberia since 2007 (office 2015), supporting NPHIL and the MOH with laboratory systems, surveillance, EOCs, the FETP (launched 2015), malaria and immunization.

nphi.title: Regional Lassa fever preparedness simulation exercises in Benin and Liberia
nphi.with: IANPHI; African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET); Integrated Quality Laboratory Services; Resolve to Save Lives; national public health institutes and ministries of 15 West African countries
nphi.summary: Two CDC-led regional simulation exercises (Cotonou and Monrovia, May 2026) with 30 participants from 15 West African countries testing cross-border coordination, surveillance, laboratory systems and outbreak response, followed by 7-1-7…

nphi.title: SLMTA training-of-trainers workshops for West African laboratory professionals
nphi.with: US CDC and CDC country offices; national public health laboratories and institutes; veterinary laboratories
nphi.summary: Two regional Strengthening Laboratory Management Toward Accreditation training-of-trainers workshops (Monrovia and Saly, April–May 2026) trained 40 laboratory professionals from 15 countries to build a regional quality and accreditation…

nphi.title: NPHIL – Africa CDC Lassa fever training for healthcare workers
nphi.actor: National Public Health Institute of Liberia (NPHIL)
nphi.with: Africa CDC
nphi.summary: Five-day joint training in June 2026 for Liberian healthcare workers on Lassa fever prevention, surveillance, case management, IPC and outbreak response.

nphi.title: Africa CDC NPHI centres of excellence
nphi.with: Nine national public health institutes (incl. NPHIL Liberia)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC funded nine national public health institutes to act as regional hubs offering technical assistance, training and mentoring to peers, with plans to twin them with European NPHIs through ECDC.

nphi.title: West Africa NPHI acceleration workshop (WAHO, Africa CDC, NCDC, US CDC, IANPHI)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; NCDC Nigeria; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs and ministries of 13 ECOWAS countries
nphi.summary: March 2024 workshop in Abuja where established, recent and nascent West African NPHIs shared lessons and drafted stage-appropriate action plans for establishing or strengthening their institutes, with requested partner support.

nphi.title: LabTrain – Drug quality assurance capacity and infrastructure in African countries
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: WHO; InphA (Germany); University of Würzburg (Germany); FDA Ghana; LMHRA (Liberia); Pharmacy Board of Sierra Leone; Medicines Control Agency (Gambia)
nphi.summary: Built drug quality control lab capacity and quality management at African regulators, with a focus on anti-infectives, aligned with WHO standards.

nphi.title: PharmTrain2 – Regulatory capacities for marketing authorisation
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: AUDA-NEPAD; FDA Ghana; LMHRA (Liberia); MCA (Gambia); MCAZ (Zimbabwe); Pharmacy Board of Sierra Leone; SAHPRA (South Africa); TMDA (Tanzania); WHO
nphi.summary: Strengthened African regulators in evaluating marketing authorisation applications and supported African Medicines Agency harmonisation.

nphi.title: VaccTrain 2.0 – Vaccine clinical trials and pharmacovigilance regulation
nphi.with: FDA Ghana; LMHRA (Liberia); MCA (Gambia); Pharmacy Board of Sierra Leone; MCAZ (Zimbabwe); Rwanda FDA; ARP (Senegal); SAHPRA (South Africa); AUDA-NEPAD AMRH; AVAREF; WHO AFRO
nphi.summary: Built regulatory capacity for vaccine clinical trial oversight and AEFI pharmacovigilance in sub-Saharan Africa.

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.

nphi.title: Support to the Regional Centre for Surveillance and Disease Control in the ECOWAS zone
nphi.with: West African Health Organisation (WAHO); ECOWAS Regional Centre for Surveillance and Disease Control (RCSDC); national public health institutes of priority countries
nphi.summary: Three-year EU-funded project implemented by GIZ within the BMZ Regional Programme Support to Pandemic Prevention in the ECOWAS Region, strengthening WAHO's RCSDC and surveillance (incl. SORMAS) with priority countries Guinea, Liberia,…

nphi.title: RegTrain – PharmTrain – Regulatory training and advice for pharmaceuticals
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: FDA Ghana; LMHRA (Liberia); Pharmacy Board Sierra Leone; MCA (Gambia); MCAZ (Zimbabwe); Paul-Ehrlich-Institut; WHO; AUDA-NEPAD
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer regulatory capacity building for medicines against infectious diseases.

nphi.title: ORDER-HC – Maintaining routine health care during epidemics
nphi.actor: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM); Robert Koch Institute (RKI)
nphi.with: IRSS/CNRST (Burkina Faso); Santé Plus (Guinea); UL-PIRE Africa (Liberia); FMOS/UCRC USTTB (Mali); Université Cheikh Anta Diop (Senegal); COMAHS, University of Sierra Leone
nphi.summary: Studied how to keep routine care running during epidemics in West Africa and informed health worker curricula.

nphi.title: RegTrain – VaccTrain – Regulatory training for vaccines and biomedicines
nphi.with: FDA Ghana; LMHRA (Liberia); Pharmacy Board of Sierra Leone; MCA (Gambia); MCAZ (Zimbabwe); AUDA-NEPAD; AVAREF; BfArM; WHO
nphi.summary: Built regulatory capacity on vaccine authorisation, pharmacovigilance and clinical trial oversight.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 048 – Improved regional management of outbreaks in the African Atlantic Façade
nphi.with: Expertise France; Institut Pasteur; Fondation Mérieux; IRD; French Ministry of Health; CNCMFE NRBC-E; FIIAPP
nphi.summary: EU-funded project in which Santé publique France, Institut Pasteur and other French and Spanish bodies built outbreak preparedness and rapid-response teams in 11 West and Central African countries after the Ebola epidemic.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 045 – EUWAM-Lab mobile laboratory for viral haemorrhagic fever outbreaks in West Africa
nphi.with: Expertise France; Fondation Mérieux; INSERM
nphi.summary: EU-funded project with Institut Pasteur and French partners that deployed a mobile laboratory and trained staff to detect risk-group-4 viruses in Ebola-affected West African countries.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: Support for creating the National Public Health Institute of Liberia
nphi.with: National Public Health Institute of Liberia (NPHIL); US CDC; WHO
nphi.summary: After Ebola, IANPHI ran a project to create a Liberian NPHI, with WHO and US CDC. The NPHI Act was signed in January 2017, and IANPHI published a case study on its legal framework.
